description: six separate pond and river objects as seen floating in or standing by water: a cluster of lily pads with a pink flower, a clump of green reeds, a clump of cattails, mossy rocks sticking out of water, a short wooden dock, a small rowing boat for a top-down 3/4 view fantasy action RPG, seen from above at an angle, soft shading lit from the upper left, a thin dark outline, rich natural colours, detailed modern pixel art; arranged in a 3 by 2 grid with wide empty space between them, every object whole, not touching the others or the picture edges; on a plain flat pure white background
